selection: Development only: rank candidates by paired common-cohort win-rate delta vs A0 subject to full-cohort hit nondecrease, secondary loss <=0.5pp, race coverage loss <=0.5pp and runner coverage loss <=1pp. Fixed order breaks ties. Carry A0 plus best qualifying A1, then best qualifying A2 relative to A1 on development. Freeze shortlist before validation; choose simpler comparator unless both validation years positive with guards. No promotion before P8B confirmation.
evaluation: NORMAL is_model_target with winning label. Intent-to-predict counts abstain and null predicted finish as miss; known-label separately. Top3 support separately. Common race AND runner cohort ranks recomputed within mutually scored runners, and native full-cohort metrics separately. No payouts.
